source: Re-grounded against the live src/ tree on 2026-05-03. Verify line ranges with the source-viewer button on each stage card; line numbers drift as code changes.

stages.title: Startup & Runtime Components
stages.tagline: Wire up Prompter, History, ActionManager, ObjectiveStack, MemoryBank, SelfPrompter, TranscriptLogger.
notes: initExamples runs in parallel via Promise.all (prompter.js ~lines 112-122) and now also initializes SkillLibrary alongside conversation/coding examples.
ObjectiveStack and TranscriptLogger are first-class runtime components initialized before History/Coder/NPC/MemoryBank (agent.js ~lines 58-86).
Spawn timeout still comes from settings.spawn_timeout; if the bot fails to spawn, the agent exits cleanly after recording lifecycle events.

stages.title: Incoming Chat
stages.tagline: Filter, optionally translate, and route player messages to handleMessage().
notes: respondFunc handles both 'chat' and 'whisper'. Bot-self messages are ignored and settings.only_chat_with still filters configured chatter before any model work.
Open chat only triggers when serverProxy.getNumOtherAgents() === 0 (agent.js ~lines 244-247), which avoids multi-bot conflicts but remains easy to miss in docs.
handleEnglishTranslation is still called twice for normal inbound chat: once in respondFunc and again in handleMessage. That is likely redundant translation work.

stages.title: Direct Command Shortcut
stages.tagline: If the player typed a valid !command, parse, validate, execute, render the result, and return. No LLM call.
notes: Short-circuits before any model call. Validation, execution, result rendering, response routing, transcript end event, then return.
!newAction is still special-cased and DOES add the message to history before execution so generated code has the user's context.
Forced user commands now save history when !newAction runs or when MemoryBank is dirty, which matters for JourneyMap/storage/route imports.

stages.title: History Update
stages.tagline: Add the new turn to History (player→user, system→system, bot→assistant) and persist.
notes: OpenAI-style role mapping. Behavior logs from modes are inserted as system messages BEFORE the user request (agent.js ~lines 378-389).
Mode behavior log is truncated at MAX_LOG=500 chars. Worth checking when a behavior log was the missing context for a bad decision.
History.add() does not save by itself; handleMessage persists after the inbound turn and after each response-loop iteration, while forced commands save only for !newAction or dirty MemoryBank.

stages.title: Prompt Preparation
stages.tagline: Fill the conversing template via replaceStrings: $NAME, $STATS, $INVENTORY, $COMMAND_DOCS, $EXAMPLES, $MEMORY, $CONVO, $LAST_GOALS, …
notes: $STATS aggregates stats + entities + nearbyBlocks. $STATS, $INVENTORY, and $EXAMPLES are cached across promptConvo retry attempts, but not across separate response-loop turns.
Example retrieval uses latestIntentText(), assistant-output overlap, and a small user-intent role boost to focus retrieval on the latest request.
$BLUEPRINTS is only replaced when agent.npc.constructions exists; otherwise the unknown-placeholder warning can still fire if a profile includes it without constructions.

stages.title: LLM Request
stages.tagline: Send prepared prompt to the chat model. Cooldowns, retries (3x), staleness checks, sanitation.
notes: Cooldown (~line 219), 3 retries (~line 218), drops stale responses if a newer user message arrived (~lines 220-221, 273-281).
Strips </think> reasoning prefixes (~lines 283-286) and filters hallucinated '(FROM OTHER BOT)' mentions (~line 263).
Returns empty string on exhaustion — caller treats empty as 'stop the loop'.

stages.title: LLM Response Handling
stages.tagline: Empty means stop. Chat replies are routed. Command replies are extracted, executed serially, and fed back before the next prompt.
notes: extractCommandMessages finds every command in a model response and handleMessage executes them in source order; the old first-command truncation behavior is gone.
Invalid commands add a rendered ERR_COMMAND_MISSING system result and the loop continues to any later queued command.
max_responses is resolved by resolveMaxResponses(): explicit caller overrides win, normal user messages cap at 1, and self-prompts with active objectives can use settings.max_commands.

stages.title: Command Execution
stages.tagline: Dispatch to commands/{actions,queries}.js, record transcript events, return result string.
notes: Strict argument validation remains: name, count, type, domain checks, and item/block existence checks.
Command returns now pass through normalizeCommandResult/renderCommandResult so legacy strings get stable OK/ERR_* prefixes before entering chat/history.
Transcript command results are capped at 4000 chars, but prompt-facing command output is still mostly the rendered command text; individual commands still need concise outputs.

stages.title: Reasoning & Re-Prompt Loop
stages.tagline: After each command, append result as a system turn and prompt the model again. Capped by max_commands.
notes: The for loop in handleMessage is still the reasoning loop; it now has an inner command loop for multiple commands emitted by one model response.
resolveMaxResponses makes response caps goal-aware: self-prompts with active objective states can use configured max_commands, while normal user messages stay capped to one.
No explicit reflection step exists yet; the model gets rendered command results and must infer recovery unless a command provides recommended next steps.

stages.title: Modes & Autonomous Follow-Up
stages.tagline: 300ms tick: update modes, run self-prompter, handle death/idle/disconnect events.
notes: 300ms tick is implemented as a serialized async loop rather than setInterval, so update() calls do not overlap if one tick runs long.
Death event grabs the position into MemoryBank.places and triggers handleMessage with a death system prompt.
Self-prompt loop stops after MAX_NO_COMMAND=3 consecutive empty responses (~line 64).

stages.title: Memory System
stages.tagline: Recent History.turns, long-term History.memory summary, typed MemoryBank namespaces, ObjectiveStack, plus TranscriptLogger for observability.
notes: When turns exceed settings.max_messages, an older chunk is removed, filtered for durable memory, queued for summarization, and archived to bots/{name}/histories/.
History.memory is still hard-capped at 500 chars, now with timeout/requeue behavior around summarization failures.
MemoryBank is no longer a flat place map: it has typed namespaces for places, JourneyMap waypoints, routes, storage, observations, and pending state. It still lacks pruning/semantic retrieval.
TranscriptLogger covers chat/model/command/memory/lifecycle/objective events, which is enough scaffolding for replay/eval work.

stages.title: Why Tool Output Quality Matters
stages.tagline: Command output text becomes the next system turn — it directly steers the next decision.
notes: Command outputs now go through a shared normalization/rendering layer with stable OK/ERR_* prefixes, but many command implementations still return legacy free-text.
Transcript logging caps oversized command results, but the prompt-facing command result still depends on each command/action keeping its output concise.
ActionManager.getBotOutputSummary now keeps both first and final output snippets for long logs; the remaining gap is preserving enough structured failure detail in only 500 chars.

stages.title: Multi-Model Layer / Prompter Internals
stages.tagline: Prompter routes promptConvo / promptCoding / promptNewActionPlan / promptMemSaving / promptVision to per-profile chat/code/vision/embedding models.
notes: _model_map.js auto-loads every adapter in src/models/ and infers the API from the model name prefix.
All adapters expose sendRequest(turns, systemMessage) and sendVisionRequest(...). New providers = new file with a static prefix.
Easy/cheap calls (memory summary, bot-responder, new-action planning) currently use the same chat_model as the main reasoning step; no dynamic routing layer exists yet.

doc_drift: Stage 2: chat only fires when getNumOtherAgents() === 0; multi-bot avoidance is still easy to miss in docs.
Stage 2: handleEnglishTranslation is called twice (event handler + handleMessage), likely a redundant translation cost.
Stage 3: !newAction adds the message to history before executing, breaking the simple 'direct commands skip history' description.
Stage 5: latestIntentText(), assistant-output overlap, and retry-local replacement caching are undocumented details that affect prompt shape and latency.
Stage 7: runtime now executes every command extracted from one model response, while the default prompt and command docs still instruct the model to use at most one command per response.
Stage 10: the 300ms serialized update loop and mode-update-then-self-prompter ordering aren't called out in the doc.
Stage 11: 500-char History.memory truncation is enforced in code, but MemoryBank is now typed and stores JourneyMap/routes/storage/observations beyond the prose summary.
Stage 12: command results now get OK/ERR_* normalization, but prompt-facing output still has no global renderer-side size budget.
Stage 13: Prompter also owns promptCoding, promptNewActionPlan, and promptVision; the doc only highlights conversation prompting and memory-saving.

  J -->|chat| L[History.add assistant + reply]

  O -->|more commands| N
  O -->|under response cap| H
  O -->|cap hit| K
